title: Why a Skyscraper Hangs a Giant Golden Ball (story v1, estimated times, 63.5 s)
thesis: A heavy ball on a long rope swings against a tower's sway and cancels it, like pushing back against a swing.
want: Pete wants to open his skinny tower tomorrow without it swaying, and to beat his rival's sleek copy.
stakes: He spent everything, even the penthouse, on the ball; if the tower sways on opening day the crowd flees and the rival takes the town's contract.
reversal: His own fix is half-done (the rope only three floors long) and he fears it is wrong, then the rival sneaks in to ruin it and cranks the rope to exactly the right length.
payoff: In the opening-day gust Pete's coffee never spills while the rival's ball-less tower sways until its rooftop pool empties onto the rival in his best suit.
retell: A man hangs a giant ball in his skyscraper and everyone laughs, until the storm makes his smug rival's tower slosh.

antagonist.who: Rex, the smug rival builder next door

weakestBeat.fix: It was a bare joke with no picture, so Pete now peeks through a drilled hole at the ball and holds up a sign reading 'I THINK'.

carrier.object: the golden ball and its rope

facts.fact: a heavy ball on a long rope swings slowly against the tower's sway and soaks it up
facts.onScreen: a kid on a playground swing next to the tower stops dead when her dad pushes back against her, then the tower and the golden ball swing against each other

beats.event: Pete winches a giant golden ball up the skinny tower's side on a groaning crane; it swings and bonks the wall
beats.consequence: a window pops out and a pigeon faints off the ledge; the ball keeps rocking
beats.funny: the ball bonks the wall, pigeon faints

beats.event: the camera pulls back: the tower is tall and skinny, Pete tiny; the banner OPENING TOMORROW flaps; next door Rex's crew builds a bigger copy and Rex waves sarcastically
beats.consequence: the ball hangs through the top floors; Rex mimes a tiny violin
beats.funny: Rex mimes a tiny violin at Pete

beats.event: Pete opens his empty wallet at the foot of the tower; the ball has taken the whole top floor where a TOP FLOOR FOR SALE sign hangs crossed out
beats.consequence: a fly buzzes out of the wallet; the ball swings and its shadow crosses the crossed-out sign

beats.event: Rex's sleek tower rises on the next plot with a rooftop pool and no ball; a crane drops the last glass panel
beats.consequence: Rex dives off a diving board into the pool just to show off
beats.funny: Rex dives into his own rooftop pool

beats.event: night wind test: a gale hits, the tower leans, the too-short rope makes the ball bang about out of step, the dummy in the top-floor chair is flung
beats.consequence: the dummy comes back wrapped in a curtain, dizzy, a window frame around its neck
beats.funny: dizzy dummy wearing a curtain and window frame

beats.event: at night Pete drills a hole through the floor and lets the rope out; the ball sinks floor by floor, then he stops after three floors, afraid to cut more
beats.consequence: plaster rains on him; the ball hangs three floors lower, still a bit short

beats.event: Pete peeks through the drilled hole at the ball, shrugs and holds up a hand-lettered sign: I THINK
beats.consequence: the ball sways a little and the sign flips upside down

beats.event: Rex laughs, sneaks into Pete's tower with a torch and cranks the winch until the ball sinks deep to smash the floor; he grins and tiptoes off
beats.consequence: the ball now hangs exactly long: it swings slow and wide in the moonlight and touches nothing
beats.funny: Rex tiptoes out, proud of his sabotage

beats.event: bright morning: the town queues around Rex's tower under a GRAND OPENING banner; kids point at its rooftop pool
beats.consequence: the pool sloshes as a diver bounces; Pete's tower stands almost empty with one sad balloon
beats.funny: queue for the pool, one sad balloon at Pete's

beats.event: Rex rides his elevator up first and waves from the roof; Pete steps into his elevator; a flag stands straight out with the first gust
beats.consequence: Rex's elevator door shuts on his tie; Pete's doors close with a gust whistling in
beats.funny: Rex's tie trapped in the elevator door

beats.event: in Pete's elevator the floor trembles; through a glass wall he sees the ball hanging deep, swinging slow as the tower begins to lean
beats.consequence: his coffee cup slides and he braces: dread on his face
beats.funny: Pete braces, gripping his coffee cup like a lifeline

beats.event: a girl on a playground swing by the tower: her dad pushes in time and she flies, then pushes back against her and she stops dead; the camera swings up to the tower and the golden ball moving against it
beats.consequence: the swing freezes mid-air with her cheerful face and the tower stops leaning
beats.funny: girl frozen mid-air on the swing, delighted

beats.event: a ghost replay of the night test: the short rope's ball swings fast out of step and flings the dummy, then the long rope's ball swings slowly against the sway
beats.consequence: a glow runs along the rope; the replayed dummy lands gently in its chair
beats.funny: replayed dummy lands gently with a thumbs up

beats.event: Pete's tower stands still in the gust while the ball swings against it; the coffee on his desk stays flat
beats.consequence: Pete floats out of the elevator without a spill and sips; the crowd gasps
beats.funny: not a single drop spills, Pete sips

beats.event: Rex's tower with no ball sways more and more; the rooftop pool sloshes higher with each swing and slops over the edge
beats.consequence: the whole pool dumps over the roof edge in a wave onto the crowd's side and onto the entrance where Rex has just stepped out
beats.funny: Rex's best suit drenched by his own pool

beats.event: close on Rex, soaked, green and seasick with a floating pool noodle round his neck; Pete in the background winks, mug raised
beats.consequence: Rex wobbles and sits down in a puddle; a rubber duck floats past
beats.funny: Rex seasick with pool noodle, rubber duck floats by
